title: Pure Ursarctic
summary: Pure Ursarctic celestial beast strategy, centered on Level 7 and Level 8 WATER monsters that Special Summon themselves during either Main Phase by tributing a high-Level monster from the hand. The deck performs dark Synchro Summons by subtracting monster Levels rather than adding them, erecting powerful Extra Deck floodgates.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ursarctic Mikpolar tributes a Level 7 or higher monster from hand as a Quick Effect to Special Summon itself and search any Ursarctic monster from your Deck.
Ursarctic Departure discards 1 card to search two Ursarctic monsters with different names from your Deck, and banishes itself from the GY to substitute for an Ursarctic monster's Tribute requirement.
Ursarctic Big Dipper acts as the engine Field Spell, allowing you to banish a Level 7 or higher Ursarctic monster from your GY instead of tributing from hand.
Ursarctic Mikbilis Special Summons another Ursarctic monster from your hand upon summon, helping assemble subtraction materials.
Ursarctic Miktanus recovers an Ursarctic monster from your GY to hand upon summon.

summary.title: Opening: Departure + Mikpolar
steps: Activate Ursarctic Departure, discarding 1 card to add Ursarctic Mikpolar and Ursarctic Megapolar (or Megatanus) from your Deck to your hand.
Activate Mikpolar's Quick Effect, tributing Megapolar to Special Summon Mikpolar in Defense Position.
Mikpolar triggers on summon to search Ursarctic Miktanus (or Ultimate Bright Knight Ursatron Alpha) from Deck.
Special Summon Ursarctic Polari from your Extra Deck by sending 1 Tuner and 1 non-Tuner from your field to the GY whose Level difference is 1 (Level 8 Tuner minus Level 7 non-Tuner).
Polari triggers on summon to activate Ursarctic Big Dipper directly from your Deck.
Tribute Polari and a banished/GY monster under Big Dipper to summon Ursarctic Septentrion.

summary.title: Dark Synchro Bosses & Control
points: Ursarctic Polari requires 1 Tuner and 1 non-Tuner with a Level difference of 1, and places Ursarctic Big Dipper face-up from your Deck on Special Summon.

Ursarctic Septentrion requires sending a Level 8 or higher Tuner and a Level 1 non-Tuner Synchro to the GY, completely negating the activated effects of all face-up Extra Deck monsters that do not have a Level (Xyz and Link Monsters).
Ursarctic Polar Star acts as an alternative Level 1 Synchro that can tribute itself to cheat out Septentrion or Grand Chariot while locking the opponent's Level-based Extra Deck monsters.
Ursarctic Grand Chariot destroys up to two cards on the field upon summon and negates cards or effects that target an Ursarctic card you control.
The Level 8 Mega Tuners (Megapolar, Megatanus, Megabilis) activate during either Main Phase to destroy a Spell/Trap, book an opponent monster face-down, or banish a card from their GY.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Ursarctic Radiation places 7 counters on activation and lets you draw 1 card each time an Ursarctic monster is Special Summoned from the hand or Extra Deck (up to 7 draws total).
Ursarctic Big Dipper accumulates counters whenever an Ursarctic is summoned, and removes 7 counters to permanently take control of an opponent's monster.
Ursarctic Slider revives an Ursarctic monster from your GY as a Quick-Play Spell, though it cannot attack and returns to hand in the End Phase.
Ursarctic Quint Charge recycles spent Ursarctics from GY or tributes two Ursarctic monsters to cheat out an Ursarctic Synchro Monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Drytron crossover cards like Ursarctic Drytron and Ultimate Flagship Ursatron are omitted to avoid Machine/Ritual conflicts and keep the build focused on pure Ursarctic subtraction mechanics.

exclude.Ursarctic Drytron: Banishes Drytron Fafnir, which the pure list doesn't play.
exclude.Ultimate Flagship Ursatron: Only Ursarctic Drytron can summon it.
